  "title": "Explain/document the push-to-talk feature in the user interface when a participant mutes or gets muted",
  "body": "I did not know at all that meet.jit.si had PTT implemented already, until I dug around in bug reports here. And I'm a geek, so imagine people who wouldn't even know spacebar Push-to-Talk is a thing!\r\n\r\nSo this is simply a discoverability issue.\r\nAn easy way to address this, therefore, is to change the popup message that (already) says this when try to speak into a muted microphone:\r\n\r\n> \"Trying to speak? You are muted. [unmute]\"\r\n\r\nAnd replace it by this (or something similar-but-clear):\r\n\r\n> \"Trying to speak? You are currently muted. You can unmute yourself by clicking the button below, or you can push-to-talk by pressing and holding the space bar on your keyboard, which will temporarily unmute you while the spacebar key is held pressed down.\"\r\n\r\nIf you want a shorter version, maybe the popup message could have a link to a secondary popup message with the explanation and screenshots or something. It could say for example:\r\n\r\n>  \"Trying to speak? You are currently muted. You can unmute yourself by clicking the button below, or you can push-to-talk with the keyboard's space bar  [unmute] [learn more about push-to-talk]\"\r\n\r\nTLDR: please make the feature _obvious_. It will be very useful to a lot of people!",
  "author": "Participant 1",
  "created_at": "2021-01-02T17:25:29Z",

    {
      "id": 753509321,
      "url": "https://github.com/jitsi/jitsi-meet/issues/8322#issuecomment-753509321",
      "created_at": "2021-01-02T18:01:38Z",
      "updated_at": null,
      "author": "Participant 2",
      "body": "Such long messages are not suitable for notifications.\r\nIf you press shift + ? or the button from the menu \"View shortcuts\", you will get a list of all shortcuts where you can see and the one for PTT."
    },
    {
      "id": 753510230,
      "url": "https://github.com/jitsi/jitsi-meet/issues/8322#issuecomment-753510230",
      "created_at": "2021-01-02T18:07:17Z",
      "updated_at": "2021-01-02T18:11:03Z",
      "author": "Participant 1",
      "body": "The kind of non-technical users I deal with will _not_ go looking for documentation / digging into menus, nor will they even _imagine_ the _possibility_ of using keyboard shortcuts. I can 100% guarantee that to you. Thinking about keyboard shortcuts is not in their reflexes, let alone searching for documentation.\r\n\r\nHence my alternative suggestion above. You could make it even shorter (to the extreme) by doing this if you prefer:\r\n\r\n> Trying to speak? You are currently muted.\r\n>    [Unmute]  [Learn about push-to-talk]\r\n\r\n...and the 2nd button shows them the info overlay with the explanation about how PTT works."
    },
    {
      "id": 766832889,
      "url": "https://github.com/jitsi/jitsi-meet/issues/8322#issuecomment-766832889",
      "created_at": "2021-01-25T13:55:48Z",
      "updated_at": null,
      "author": "Participant 3",
      "body": "@nekohayo as an alternative if you self-host you can modify the language file to show a better message. Agreed it would be of great benefit to improve discoverability for this feature.\r\nI've been away from Jitsi for some time but perhaps we could put together a less-than-one-page \"Getting started\" leaflet to share with first-time users. I know many teachers who would love this.\r\nRest assured other popular tools (Google Classrooms) have worse usability, at least here we can hope, propose or implement improvements."
    },
    {
      "id": 868934448,
      "url": "https://github.com/jitsi/jitsi-meet/issues/8322#issuecomment-868934448",
      "created_at": "2021-06-26T02:57:37Z",
      "updated_at": null,
      "author": "Participant 4",
      "body": "This issue has been automatically marked as stale because it has not had recent activity. It will be closed if no further activity occurs. Thank you for your contributions.\n"
    },
    {
      "id": 869013069,
      "url": "https://github.com/jitsi/jitsi-meet/issues/8322#issuecomment-869013069",
      "created_at": "2021-06-26T14:45:09Z",
      "updated_at": null,
      "author": "Participant 1",
      "body": "The problem with the one-page-leaflet-intro-tutorial approach is that 1) people tend to not read when they're in a hurry / stressed, and that's often what may happen when they first join  2) they will forget.\r\n\r\nThat's why I thought it made more sense to have it in the notification, as it would always be there as reminder."
    },
